main_text.p: צלב Ch. & Syr. Suspendere, crucifigere. Ithpehal אצטליב, Suspendi, Crucifigi.
צליב Ch. & Syr. Suspensus, Crucifixus. Plur. צליבין.
צליבא Ch. Crux, patibulum: Suspensio, Ruth.1.17.
צלהב Pahel Ch. Ardere, Flammare, candere, splendere. Part. מצלהב Ardens, ignitū, candens, splendens.
צלהוב Ch. Flamma: metaphoricè, Mucro, Acies gladii flammans, Nahum 3.3.

צלח Ch. Prosperari, secundari; Prosperum, secundum esse: Item Scindere, discindere, findere, diffindere, dilfecare. Pahel צלח Idem. Aphel אצלח Prosperare, prosperum efficere, secundare: & passive, Prosperari, Secundari.
צלוחיתא, צלוחירת Chal. Paropsis, Scutella: Item Lecythus, Ampulla.
צלל Hebr. Tinnire, palpitare. Hinc Ch. צלא Tinnierunt, palpitârunt, Hab.3.16. Vide quoque in צלא. Pahel Syr. Excolare, percolare, Matthaei 23.24.
צליל Ch. Limpidum, clarum, quasi Percolatum. Plur. מין צלילן Aquae limpidae, clarae, Exo.7.24. in Jon. emphat. צלילתא, Genes.1.21. in Jon.
צלצלא Ch. Cymbalum, Syr. 1.ad Cor.13.1. Plural. צלצלין & צלצלין Cymbala, Psal.150.5.
צלצול Ch. Cingulū. Plur. צלצולין Cingula, Num.5.18.in (T. Jon.

page.notes: Some Syriac and Hebrew vocalisation marks are small and partly uncertain; Syriac words transcribed as printed as far as legible.
